description: Classifies utterances with a pretrained Model2Vec static-embedding intent classifier restricted to intents registered by loaded skills. The default model is multilingual, distilled from LaBSE.
notes: Single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own medium-confidence gate; per-plugin config keeps the shipped defaults. The pinned model's classifier head carries 161 labels aimed at an older OVOS skill fleet: 20 of them appear in ovos-intents-v5, 15 in golden-utterances, none in intents-for-eval, and 141 in no registered corpus at all. It can therefore emit no registered corpus's label set, so label_set is empty and the fighter is unranked until a corpus it was trained on is registered. Published predictions are migrated from the legacy ovos-intent-benchmark, where this engine was trained on the benchmark's own corpora.
